categories.description: Files, devices and connectivity for build steps.

options.summary: Mount a host directory during RUN steps
options.detail: Use absolute host and container paths. Repeat for more mounts. Access defaults to rw. Add :ro for read-only, :z for shared SELinux relabeling, or :Z for private relabeling. :U recursively changes ownership on the host. :O uses a temporary writable overlay. Mount propagation defaults to private. shared propagates in both directions and slave from host to container. Prefix r for recursive propagation. The manuals describe :O as rootful only and incompatible with :z and :Z. Each RUN starts with the original source contents. Also spelled -v.
